data.description:
## Goal
Long sessions must not sit in the remote fallback tier for 15+ minutes. Make fallback deterministic: fail fast on a stalled gateway and bound retries on an empty upstream response.

## Evidence (2026-09-14, /var/log/llama-proxy)
- 140 "Upstream ReadTimeout", 114 "Upstream stall after content delivered: terminating stream without retry timeout=240.0s", 33 "Upstream stall: retrying", 62 "Mid-stream re-route".
- 2341 fallbacks: local-qwen3 to deepseek-flash 1088, local-qwen3 to opencode-go 1025, opencode-go to deepseek-flash 110.
- "Empty response detected on stream attempt 1/4, retrying in 3.00s (provider=deepseek model=deepseek-flash ...)" - a 4-attempt retry loop on an empty upstream body.
- Client-visible symptom: pi session herdr-1789404733-1187468-16836 received "We were unable to start processing your request within the 900-second timeout limit. Please try again later." six times between 19:18 and 20:46 (about 17-18 min apart).

## Notes
- The first remote entry is opencode.ai/zen/go and it is the entry that stalls. The three opencode-go entries share endpoint and model, so they form one failure domain and the chain hops straight to deepseek after the first stall - that part works as designed.
- The deepseek entries are time-windowed via available_times ["00:00-01:00","04:00-06:00","10:00-00:00"], so outside those UTC windows there is no deepseek fallback at all.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Time-to-failover on a stalled remote gateway is bounded and documented; a 240 s silent stall does not sit in the critical path.
- [ ] Empty upstream responses are retried within a bounded, configurable budget that is logged.
- [ ] The deepseek time-window gap (UTC 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00) is either closed or explicitly documented as accepted risk.
- [ ] A regression test asserts bounded failover for a stalling then empty upstream.
- [ ] Full test suite green.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **LP-0MSCGTYWA006NAZC** – Fix remote 400: sanitizer strips reasoning_content, breaking Console Go thinking-mode round-trip (completed)
- **LP-0MTVMB685003GO2F** – Scope remote failure-domain exclusion by upstream model behind router endpoints (completed)
- **LP-0MSC4UP71005B8QW** – Sanitize tool-call history before remote sends (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `proxy/README.md` — matched: 00s, accepted, again, asserts, attempt (+106 more)
- `ds4/gguf-tools/imatrix/dataset/rendered_prompts.txt` — matched: acceptance, accepted, again, apart, asserts (+104 more)
- `ds4/gguf-tools/imatrix/dataset/rendered_prompts_nothink.txt` — matched: acceptance, accepted, again, apart, asserts (+104 more)
